name: phil/media-bundle
description: A media library for Symfony: files and versions on any Flysystem storage, collections, images transformed around their focal point to WebP, AVIF, JPEG or PNG with GD or libvips, tiny previews, purified SVG, responsive Img and Picture components, a file explorer with a picker, a Doctrine column type, and signed URLs served as user content

suggest.easycorp/easyadmin-bundle: For MediaField, the field of a medium in EasyAdmin
suggest.league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3: To keep files in an S3 bucket
suggest.phil/browser-security-bundle: To serve every file under its policy of user content
suggest.phil/creation-disclosure: To declare how a medium was made as an IPTC digital source type
suggest.phil/svg-sanitizer: To purify and minify SVG images before they are kept
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the explorer's Stimulus controllers without a build step
suggest.symfony/form: For MediaPickerType, the field that opens the picker
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the Img and Picture components
suggest.symfony/web-link: To preload the main image of a page, with priority
suggest.twig/twig: For media_url(), media_schema(), the explorer and the components
